node.statement: By def-one-dimensional-delta-projection, dim S_Q=1 says exactly that Q is a one-dimensional delta-projection. Taking a positive universal threshold below those in lem-compcb-corner-algebra and the registered compression/dichotomy estimates, and absorbing c_D,c_Q into the accuracy parameter allowed by lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity, establishes every assertion of node 1.1 without dependence on r.
